item.description:
A spirited 7th-grade quarterback named Casey discovers a mysterious book that can bring the dead back to life. Hoping to see her late mother again, she performs the spell—but something goes hilariously wrong, and her fashion doll, Eve, comes to life instead. As the two navigate the chaos of real-world life, they form an unexpected friendship that helps Casey heal, her father reconnect, and Eve discover what it truly means to be human.
